hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: A token launch platform hook denominated in a tokenized ERC-20 stock. Charges a fixed swap fee (0–5%, configured per pool at launch) split between creator, bid wall, and platform. Automatically manages a single-sided quote-token bid wall just below spot price. Liquidity additions are locked to the factory until the pool reaches a configured graduation tick, after which the pool opens to all liquidity providers.
